title: Fried Brussels Sprouts
description: These fried Brussels sprouts with tender sliced onions and crispy bacon are quick and easy to make for a tasty, kid-pleasing vegetable side dish.
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, cut into bite-size pieces
1 (12 ounce) package fresh Brussels sprouts, trimmed and sliced
2 tablespoons white sugar, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Place bacon pieces in a large skillet and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 7 to 10 minutes. Drain on paper towels, leaving grease in the skillet.

Cook onion in the bacon grease in the skillet until translucent, about 5 minutes. Add Brussels sprouts and toss to coat in the bacon grease. Cook and stir until browned and tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in sugar, salt, and black pepper; sprinkle in bacon pieces.

video.description: With a little help from bacon and a touch of sugar, you can make Brussels sprouts the most sought-after vegetable on your table . . . even by youngsters and veggie-resistant eaters! Simply fry up your bacon crispy, then cook onion in the bacon grease, add thinly sliced Brussels sprouts and cook until browned and tender. Season with sugar, salt and pepper for the perfect balance of flavors without the bitterness. Bring home the bacon flavor by cutting up the cooked bacon into bite-sized pieces and sprinkling back into the sprouts. This delicious preparation will become a new favorite for pleasing fussy eaters and sprout lovers alike!
